Class UltraHdrImageSource

java.lang.Object
de.christianmahnke.iiif.fliiifenleger.ultrahdr.UltraHdrImageSource
All Implemented Interfaces:
HdrSource, ImageSource
@AutoService(ImageSource.class) public class UltraHdrImageSource extends Object implements ImageSource, HdrSource
An ImageSource for UltraHDR JPEGs: the primary (SDR) image is decoded through the regular ImageIO pipeline, while the gain map and its ISO 21496-1 metadata are split out via the ultrahdr WASM codec and exposed through the HdrSource capability (see HdrFrame.gainmap()).

Plain JPEGs without a gain map are handled gracefully: the source behaves like DefaultImageSource and getHdrFrame() returns null.

Threading: the WASM codec keeps thread-affine state — see GainMapCodec for the single-thread architecture.
